prompts: Use case: ads-marketing / infographic-diagram. Create ONE polished square LinkedIn project showcase image, option 1: clean editorial architecture infographic. Project title exactly "RoleLens". Subtitle exactly "Three agents. One clear workflow." The project is a Python resume-job matching application using LangGraph orchestration and Ollama. Show exactly three numbered large cards connected sequentially by arrows, visually arranged vertically with generous space: "01 Resume Parser", smaller "Skills • Experience • Education"; "02 Scorer / Ranker", smaller "Semantic + rule-based fit · 0–1"; "03 Interview Questions", smaller "Tailored to candidate gaps". Show small input documents labeled "Resume" and "Job description" feeding the first card. Minimal refined vector-like illustration, paper-white background, deep ink typography and emerald accents, beautifully aligned grid, large readable sans-serif type, premium technical editorial design, not a busy dashboard. Bottom small line exactly "LangGraph · Ollama · Python". No invented performance metrics, no hiring guarantees, no corporate logos, no watermark. Make it legible in a mobile LinkedIn feed. This is a standalone finished image, not a collage of alternatives.
